description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-tasks-client/tests/task_list_tests.rs plus tests/fixtures/tasks/session.json. 4 async wiremock tests. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §3 (TaskList, TaskRights wire names); RFC 8620 §5.1 §5.2 §5.3.

**Step 1:** Create tests/fixtures/tasks/session.json with urn:ietf:params:jmap:tasks in capabilities, primaryAccounts["urn:ietf:params:jmap:tasks"] = "A13824", apiUrl as placeholder.

**Tests:**
1. task_list_get_sends_correct_wire_request: mock returns GetResponse<TaskList> with one list (id=list1, name=My Tasks, myRights with all 7 booleans); assert resp.list[0].id=="list1" and name=="My Tasks" and my_rights.may_rsvp==false; assert request has methodCalls[0][0]=="TaskList/get" and ids==null. Oracle: §3 TaskRights field names.
2. task_list_changes_sends_since_state: mock returns ChangesResponse; assert old_state=="state-1", created==["list2"]; assert request has sinceState=="state-1" and maxChanges==50.
3. task_list_set_on_destroy_remove_tasks_round_trip: call with onDestroyRemoveTasks=Some(true), destroy ["list1"]; assert resp.destroyed==["list1"]; assert request has onDestroyRemoveTasks:true and destroy==["list1"]. Oracle: §3.3 onDestroyRemoveTasks.
4. task_list_set_without_on_destroy_omits_field: call with onDestroyRemoveTasks=None; assert request does NOT contain onDestroyRemoveTasks key.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 4 tests pass. session.json created.
